name: The Game Room
body: At the knee where the hallway bends. PC rigs, consoles, a retro arcade cabinet, a DDR pad Pepper has claimed as her personal chaos platform, dimmable lighting and a mini-fridge. Ophelia's sanctuary — when the ADHD brain needs to hyperfocus rather than scatter she retreats here and speedruns until the world makes sense. Zelda follows. She always follows. The whiteboard tracking Ophelia's personal bests carries a lot of asterisks, and every asterisk is Zelda.
